the subcellular distribution of ATP citrate lyas in hepatocytes is 95% cytosolic and 5% mitochondrial matrix.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
digitonin is an effective and convenient tool for rapid fractionation of isolated cells, but it must be used with caution.

digitonin fractionations can be carried out at 1 degrees or less, with a minimum of 3s exposure to fractionation medium, and that digitonin can be used to determine subcellular distribution of most enzymes in a single fractionation of isolated cells.
